title: Travelling Allowance · Batch 01
speaker: User-selected Indian voice; everyday city-Hinglish narration

beats.heading: 01A  |  Public service comes first
beats.rule: TA relates to expenses of travel in the interest of public service.
beats.example: Delhi to Jaipur for an authorised inspection: check tour TA rules.
beats.trap: A personal weekend in Jaipur is not an official tour.
beats.key: FIRST ASK: Why is the journey being made?
lines: Hey everyone! Batch One में हम Travelling Allowance, यानी टी ए, की basics आसान Hinglish में सीखेंगे।
टी ए official duty के लिए होने वाले travel costs से जुड़ा है; ये हर personal trip का पैसा नहीं है।
मान लो Delhi का एक employee office inspection के लिए Jaipur जाता है: approved trip पर rules के हिसाब से टी ए check होगा।
लेकिन वही employee family के साथ weekend trip करे, तो वो official tour नहीं है।

beats.heading: 01B  |  TA is not the same as LTC
beats.rule: DoE issues civilian TA orders; DoPT is relevant to LTC and other service topics.
beats.example: Official training = TA inquiry. Home-town leave = separate LTC inquiry.
beats.trap: Armed Forces and Railways have separate orders to check.
beats.key: Same employee + same destination can mean different rulebooks.
lines: एक और important बात: टी ए और एल टी सी same नहीं हैं।
Central Government civilian टी ए के orders Department of Expenditure देता है; एल टी सी और service rules के लिए DoPT की guidelines भी check करें।
Example: official training की trip और छुट्टी में home town जाने का claim, दो अलग cases हैं।
Railway और Armed Forces के लिए अलग orders भी हो सकते हैं, इसलिए अपनी service के rules जरूर check करें।

beats.heading: 02A  |  Issue date is not effective date
beats.rule: The 2017 revision applies from 1 July; earlier journeys are regulated under the prior order.
beats.example: 30 June 2017 and 2 July 2017 journeys require separate date checks.
beats.trap: Do not assume 13 July is the effective date.
beats.key: Issue date and effective date are different questions.
lines: अब dates की बात। Main टी ए order thirteen July twenty seventeen को issue हुआ, लेकिन changes one July twenty seventeen से effective थे।
मान लो trip thirty June को खत्म हुआ: पुराने rules check होंगे; two July वाले trip के लिए new rules से शुरू करें।
मतलब issue date और effective date एक नहीं हैं।

beats.heading: 02B  |  Existing higher entitlement may be protected
beats.rule: If the revised entitlement lowers an existing one, the OM preserves the earlier entitlement as stated.
beats.example: A documented higher old travel class needs a saving-clause check.
beats.trap: The 2008 order is not useless for every historical or protected case.
beats.key: Check the earlier entitlement; protection is not an automatic upgrade.
lines: अब old entitlement वाली safety check। अगर नया order किसी individual या group की पहले से मिली travel class या mode को कम करता है, तो saving clause के हिसाब से पुरानी higher entitlement जारी रहती है, जब तक normal course में उससे higher entitlement न मिले।
Example: किसी officer की पुरानी approved class new table से better थी, तो office से saving clause और पुराने proof check कराएं।
इसका मतलब हर employee को automatic upgrade नहीं मिलता।

sections.title: Pay Level is not pay amount

beats.heading: 03A  |  What counts as pay in the level?
beats.rule: The 2017 order uses basic pay in the relevant matrix level, excluding NPA, MSP and other pay.
beats.example: Basic Rs 50,000 + NPA Rs 10,000: pay in the level is Rs 50,000.
beats.trap: Do not add NPA or special pay into this definition.
beats.key: Pay Level decides the row; basic pay is a separate amount.
lines: टी ए की entitlement Pay Level से तय होती है; Pay Level और pay amount same चीज़ नहीं हैं।
Twenty seventeen order में Pay in the Level का मतलब matrix वाले level का basic pay है; एन पी ए, एम एस पी या special pay इसमें नहीं जोड़ते।
मान लो basic pay fifty thousand rupees है और एन पी ए ten thousand: इस definition में pay fifty thousand ही है, sixty thousand नहीं।

beats.heading: 03B  |  Entitlement and calculation are separate
beats.rule: The calculation basis depends on the particular TA component and its conditions.
beats.example: First identify Level 7; then read the applicable journey-entitlement row.
beats.trap: A travel-class table does not determine every transfer-grant calculation.
beats.key: A matrix level is not a rupee amount.
lines: अब एक और example: Level Seven employee अपना travel class Level Six to Eleven वाली row में check करेगा।
लेकिन हर टी ए component का calculation अलग हो सकता है।
सिर्फ travel class वाली table देखकर transfer grant का amount decide मत करिए; उस component की conditions अलग check होंगी।

beats.heading: 04A  |  Levels 12 and above
beats.rule: Level 14+ has Business/Club air or AC-I; Levels 12–13 have Economy air or AC-I.
beats.example: A Level 13A officer receives the Level 13 TA / DA entitlement.
beats.trap: Level 13A does not automatically become Level 14 Business class.
beats.key: Domestic official tour/training • approval and booking rules still apply.
lines: Official tour या training में domestic travel के लिए pay level से class तय होती है।
Level Fourteen और ऊपर Business या Club air, या train में ए सी First; Level Twelve और Thirteen Economy air, या ए सी First देखेंगे।
Example: Level Thirteen A को टी ए और Daily Allowance में Level Thirteen जैसा treatment मिलता है; सिर्फ A होने से Business class नहीं मिलती।
Trip का approval और booking rules भी जरूरी हैं।

beats.heading: 04B  |  Levels 6–11 and 5 & below
beats.rule: L6–11: Economy air or AC-II; L5 and below: First / AC-III / AC Chair Car by train.
beats.example: Level 7 can be Economy-air entitled for an authorised official tour.
beats.trap: Ordinary LTC air entitlement for Levels 6–8 is different; check special schemes.
beats.key: A tour entitlement is not automatically an LTC entitlement.
lines: Level Six से Eleven: Economy air या train में ए सी Second। Level Five और नीचे: First Class, ए सी Third या ए सी Chair Car by train।
Example: Level Seven employee approved official tour पर Economy flight की entitlement रख सकता है।
लेकिन Levels Six से Eight के लिए ordinary एल टी सी में वही air entitlement नहीं होती; कुछ special एल टी सी schemes अलग हो सकती हैं।
तो tour और एल टी सी को mix मत करिए।

beats.heading: 05A  |  Listed premium-train classes
beats.rule: The OM specifies class bands, Premium Tatkal charges and named dynamic/flexi fares.
beats.example: A Level 7 official checks AC Second or Shatabdi Chair Car, as applicable.
beats.trap: Highest-class and flexi-fare wording is train-specific.
beats.key: Use the precise named service, class and permitted fare.
lines: कुछ premium trains के लिए अलग table है; list में Rajdhani, Shatabdi, Duronto, Premium, Premium Tatkal और Suvidha हैं।
Level Twelve और ऊपर Executive या ए सी First, Level Six से Eleven ए सी Second या Shatabdi Chair Car, और Level Five व नीचे ए सी Third या Chair Car check करते हैं।
Example: Level Seven का employee Shatabdi में अपनी Chair Car entitlement check करेगा, Executive class assume नहीं करेगा।

Premium Tatkal charges और Shatabdi, Rajdhani, Duronto के dynamic या flexi fare के लिए order का exact wording देखें; fixed fare Tatkal Seva charges भी जारी हैं। Example: eligible Shatabdi ticket पर dynamic fare claim करते समय order की conditions check करें।

beats.heading: 05B  |  Tejas and the 2023 train update
beats.rule: On stated journeys, Tejas and Vande Bharat follow Shatabdi; Humsafar follows Rajdhani.
beats.example: Level 7 on tour: check Shatabdi Chair Car for Vande Bharat or Tejas; Rajdhani class for Humsafar.
beats.trap: A train name does not automatically entitle an employee to Executive class.
beats.key: Use the matching class and journey purpose in the 2022 and 2023 orders.
lines: अब twenty twenty three का train update। Tejas और Vande Bharat की entitlement Shatabdi जैसी, और Humsafar की Rajdhani जैसी है।
ये mapping tour, training, transfer और retirement वाली listed journeys पर check होती है।
Example: Level Seven employee approved Vande Bharat tour के लिए Shatabdi वाली Chair Car check करेगा; Humsafar के लिए Rajdhani वाली class देखेगा।
Train का नाम Executive class का automatic pass नहीं है।

beats.heading: 06A  |  When a place is not connected by rail
beats.rule: Where places are not rail-connected, AC-II-and-above entitled travellers may use AC bus.
beats.example: A Level 7 officer may use an authorised AC bus to an unconnected place.
beats.trap: This is not the complete private-taxi / road-mileage rule.
beats.key: Start by asking whether the two places are rail-connected.
lines: जब दो जगहें rail से connected नहीं हैं, तो ए सी Second और ऊपर की train entitlement वाले employees को ए सी bus की छूट है; बाकी लोग Deluxe या ordinary bus check करें।
Example: Level Seven को ऐसे destination पर जाना है जहाँ rail connection नहीं है; वो बाकी conditions के साथ ए सी bus देख सकता है।
ये rule पूरी taxi या road mileage table नहीं है।

beats.heading: 06B  |  Rail-connected road travel & seats
beats.rule: Public road fare between rail-connected places must not exceed entitled train-class fare.
beats.example: Bus Rs 900 vs entitled rail Rs 1,000: this fare condition is satisfied.
beats.trap: No entitled seat permits lower class under this clause, not automatic upgrade.
beats.key: An above-cap fare is not automatically payable under this clause.
lines: अगर दोनों जगहें rail से connected हैं, तो public road transport allowed है, पर total fare आपके entitled train fare से ज्यादा नहीं होना चाहिए।
Example: bus fare nine hundred और entitled train fare one thousand rupees है, तो ये fare condition पूरी है; बाकी checks अभी भी जरूरी हैं।
और मान लो Level Seven की ए सी Second seat नहीं मिलती: इस rule में lower class में जा सकते हैं; higher class का automatic upgrade नहीं मिलता।

sections.title: Official-tour air booking: rules and clocks

beats.heading: TOUR TA  /  GOVERNMENT-ACCOUNT BOOKING
beats.rule: For the official-tour air booking described in the 2022 OM, check the authorised agent and entitled-class best available fare.
beats.example: For a 10 am departure, compare fares in the 09:00–12:00 slot, with the stated 10% band.
beats.trap: Unauthorised booking is not automatically regularised; the OM specifies a limited relaxation authority.
beats.key: Sanction and tour purpose matter; this instruction is about air passage, not every rail ticket.
lines: Official tour पर Government account से air ticket के लिए twenty twenty two order तीन authorised agents बताता है: Balmer Lawrie, Ashok Travels and Tours, और आई आर सी टी सी।

Entitled class में Best Available Fare fixed three hour slot से check करें; convenience के लिए stated ten percent band भी देखें। Example: ten A M departure का slot nine से twelve है, rolling window नहीं।
ये air booking rule हर rail ticket पर नहीं लगता। Unauthorised booking में limited relaxation के लिए competent authority की conditions check करें।

beats.heading: TOUR TA  /  21 DAYS AND TWO 72-HOUR CLOCKS
beats.rule: The OM encourages booking 21 days ahead, requires a reason for tour booking under 72 hours, and a separate post-journey certificate.
beats.example: An urgent tour booked 2 days ahead needs the stated justification; completion certification is a separate step.
beats.trap: The 21-day encouragement is not a universal automatic forfeiture rule.
beats.key: The two 72-hour requirements start from different events.
lines: Twenty one days पहले booking encouraged है, लेकिन इसे हर case में mandatory deadline मत मानिए। Tour ticket departure से less than seventy two hours पहले book हो तो self declared reason देना होगा।
Example: urgent tour की ticket दो दिन पहले book हुई, तो reason तैयार रखें। Journey complete होने के बाद seventy two hours के अंदर prescribed completion certificate भी देना है। दोनों clocks अलग हैं।
Government account की air travel पर mileage points generate नहीं होने चाहिए।

sections.title: Daily allowance on tour: three heads
sections.source: DoE 2017 OM Annex 2.E · DoE DA order 12 Mar 2024

beats.heading: TOUR TA  /  THE THREE COMPONENTS
beats.rule: Tour daily allowance has separate accommodation, local-travel and food components.
beats.example: A train ticket is a journey expense; hotel, eligible city travel and food have separate rules.
beats.trap: Daily Allowance on tour is not the monthly Dearness Allowance percentage.
beats.key: Identify the journey and each tour-allowance component separately.
lines: अब official tour की Daily Allowance समझते हैं। इसमें तीन अलग components हैं: eligible hotel stay, city के अंदर travel, और food का lump sum।
Example: किसी employee की train ticket journey fare है। Hotel, local travel और food को अलग rules से check किया जाता है।
यहाँ Daily Allowance को salary वाले Dearness Allowance के साथ confuse मत करिए।

beats.heading: TOUR TA  /  DEARNESS-LINKED INCREASE
beats.rule: The listed ceilings or lump sums rise 25% when Dearness Allowance increases by 50%, as each clause specifies.
beats.example: Level 7 food base Rs 800 becomes Rs 1,000 after the first 25% increase.
beats.trap: A move from 50% to 60% Dearness Allowance is not itself another 50-point increase.
beats.key: Use the journey date and the specific component's escalation clause.
lines: Twenty seventeen order में listed hotel, food और कुछ travel ceilings, Dearness Allowance के fifty percent increase पर twenty five percent बढ़ते हैं।
January twenty twenty four से Dearness Allowance fifty percent हुआ। Example: Level Seven का food base eight hundred rupees था, first increase के बाद one thousand rupees बनता है।
Fifty से sixty percent जाने पर अपने आप एक और twenty five percent increase मत जोड़िए। Journey date और latest order check करें।

sections.title: Hotel ceiling, self-certification and GST
sections.source: DoE 2017 Annex 2.E(ii) · DoE GST OM 29 Jun 2018

beats.heading: TOUR TA  /  HOTEL: UPDATED GENERAL CEILINGS
beats.rule: The table applies the first 25% increase to the 2017 hotel ceilings; admissible actual stay is reimbursed up to the applicable ceiling.
beats.example: Level 9: an eligible Rs 2,000 room charge is not automatically the Rs 2,812.50 ceiling.
beats.trap: A ceiling is a maximum, not an automatic daily cash payment.
beats.key: Separate the room charge, admissible ceiling, tax and evidence.
lines: First increase के बाद general hotel ceilings per day हैं: Level Fourteen और ऊपर nine thousand three hundred seventy five rupees; Level Twelve से Thirteen A five thousand six hundred twenty five।

Level Nine से Eleven two thousand eight hundred twelve rupees fifty paise; Level Six से Eight nine hundred thirty seven rupees fifty paise; Level Five और नीचे five hundred sixty two rupees fifty paise।
Example: Level Nine का eligible room charge two thousand rupees है, तो सिर्फ ceiling बड़ी होने से पूरा ceiling amount नहीं मिलता। Tax और proof अलग check करें।

beats.heading: TOUR TA  /  HOTEL PROOF AND TAX
beats.rule: Up to Level 8, normal hotel claims may be self-certified; the special Class X-city ceiling requires relevant vouchers.
beats.example: For a qualifying Level 7 Class X-city stay, check the Rs 1,250 escalated ceiling and produce the voucher.
beats.trap: The special voucher rule and GST proof cannot be assumed away by general self-certification.
beats.key: 2018 DoE OM: admissible taxes/GST are above the ceiling, on the eligible room charge.
lines: Level Eight और नीचे general hotel claim में, stated conditions पर self certification possible है। Stay period और place जैसी details दीजिए।

Class X city में इन levels के लिए special ceiling का twenty seventeen base one thousand था, जो first increase के बाद one thousand two hundred fifty rupees बनता है। इस special ceiling के लिए relevant voucher चाहिए।

Example: Level Seven का eligible Class X stay voucher के साथ इस ceiling पर check होगा। Twenty eighteen order में tax और GST ceiling से अलग हैं, लेकिन GST eligible actual room charge पर calculate होगा।

sections.title: Food lump sum: time and midnight

beats.heading: TOUR TA  /  FOOD AMOUNTS BY LEVEL
beats.rule: Food is a time-adjusted lump sum, not a separate food-bill reimbursement.
beats.example: For an eligible Level 7 tour, the full-day food reference amount is Rs 1,000 after the first increase.
beats.trap: Free boarding/lodging and other specific conditions must be checked separately.
beats.key: The table is a reference amount; the payable percentage depends on absence.
lines: Food के लिए अलग bill reimbursement नहीं है; eligible tour पर time के हिसाब से lump sum लगता है। Food voucher की जरूरत नहीं है।

First increase के बाद full day reference amounts: Level Fourteen और ऊपर fifteen hundred, Level Twelve से Thirteen A twelve fifty, Level Nine से Eleven eleven twenty five, Level Six से Eight one thousand, और Level Five और नीचे six hundred twenty five rupees।
Example: Level Seven के लिए reference one thousand rupees है, लेकिन कितना मिलेगा ये उसी day की eligible absence पर depend करेगा।

beats.heading: TOUR TA  /  CALCULATE EACH CALENDAR DAY
beats.rule: For each midnight-to-midnight day: under 6 hours = 30%, 6–12 = 70%, over 12 = 100%.
beats.example: Level 7: 8 pm departure and 5 am return next day = 4h + 5h; Rs 300 + Rs 300.
beats.trap: Do not add hours across midnight and apply one slab to the whole trip.
beats.key: Apply the percentage to each eligible day, subject to applicable conditions.
lines: हर midnight to midnight day पर absence अलग count होती है। Six hours से कम पर thirty percent, six से twelve hours पर seventy percent, और twelve hours से ज्यादा पर hundred percent।
Example: Level Seven eligible tour के लिए रात eight बजे निकला और अगली सुबह five बजे वापस आया। पहले day four hours और दूसरे day five hours हैं।
दोनों days thirty percent हैं। पहले day three hundred rupees और दूसरे day three hundred rupees, total six hundred rupees food amount check होगा। Free meals और बाकी conditions भी check करें।

sections.title: City travel on tour: limits and evidence

beats.heading: TOUR TA  /  LOCAL TRAVEL BY PAY LEVEL
beats.rule: City-travel limits differ by level and mode; the amount is for eligible actual travel.
beats.example: Level 9 incurs Rs 300 eligible non-AC city travel; the Rs 422.50 ceiling is not a flat payment.
beats.trap: Do not apply the per-day city cap as an intercity per-kilometre road mileage rate.
beats.key: The Level 11-and-below rupee ceilings shown include the first 25% increase.
lines: Tour city travel में Level Fourteen और ऊपर official need के हिसाब से actual eligible ए सी taxi। Level Twelve से Thirteen A के लिए ए सी taxi up to fifty kilometres per day।

First increase के बाद non ए सी daily ceilings: Level Nine से Eleven four hundred twenty two rupees fifty paise; Level Six से Eight two hundred eighty one rupees twenty five paise; Level Five और नीचे one hundred forty one rupees twenty five paise।
Example: Level Nine का eligible city taxi expense three hundred rupees है, तो cap four twenty two fifty होने से वो automatic flat amount नहीं बनता।

beats.heading: TOUR TA  /  ACTUAL EXPENSE AND SELF-CERTIFICATION
beats.rule: For qualifying city travel, Levels 9–11 may self-certify under the 2020 OM; Level 8 and below has the earlier provision.
beats.example: Level 10 records the correct amount, travel period and vehicle number for an eligible cab.
beats.trap: A free government vehicle is not a paid taxi expense, and the relaxation is not for hotel proof.
beats.key: Eligibility, actual expense, cap and the correct proof must all match.
lines: Level Nine से Eleven के eligible city travel पर twenty twenty order ने voucher की condition हटाई, लेकिन self certification में travel period और vehicle number जैसी details जरूरी हैं।
Level Eight और नीचे पहले वाले self certification rule को check करें। Example: Level Ten employee actual eligible cab cost और vehicle number सही record करता है।
Government की free car मिली हो तो उसका paid taxi expense नहीं बना। ये city travel relaxation, hotel proof को automatically replace नहीं करती।

sections.title: Tour local travel: evidence and actual expense

beats.heading: OFFICIAL UPDATE  /  LOCAL TRAVEL ON TOUR
beats.rule: The 2020 OM removes the voucher condition for eligible Level 9–11 city-travel claims on tour, with self-certification.
beats.example: Level 10 employee states the travel period and vehicle number for official local visits.
beats.trap: The entitlement, applicable ceiling and other conditions still matter.
beats.key: Self-certification is not a flat payment or permission for invented expenses.
lines: Official tour पर local travel की reimbursement, actual expense और बाकी conditions पर depend करती है।
DoE के twenty twenty clarification ने Pay Level Nine से Eleven के लिए city travel vouchers की condition हटाई, लेकिन self certification में travel period और vehicle number जैसी details देनी हैं।
Example: Level Ten employee official visits के लिए cab लेता है। Receipt नहीं है, तो वो सही expense और vehicle number self certify करता है; applicable limits और बाकी checks अभी भी जरूरी हैं।

beats.heading: OFFICIAL UPDATE  /  FREE BOARDING IS NOT FREE TRAVEL
beats.rule: The 2018 clarification permits eligible incurred local travel despite free boarding and lodging, subject to the rules.
beats.example: A trainee receives free hotel and meals but pays for an eligible official local journey.
beats.trap: The Level 9–11 voucher relaxation is for tour city travel, not every hotel, food, transfer or LTC claim.
beats.key: Identify the component and its own documentation rule.
lines: Free boarding और lodging मिलने पर भी, tour के लिए genuinely incurred local travel applicable rules के हिसाब से claim हो सकता है।
Example: trainee को free hotel और meals मिले, लेकिन official local trip का allowed खर्च खुद दिया। वो उस खर्च को rules और evidence के साथ check करेगा।
Level Nine से Eleven की ये voucher relaxation hotel, food, transfer या एल टी सी के हर claim पर automatically लागू नहीं होती।

sections.title: Road mileage: prescribed and fallback rates

beats.heading: ROAD TA  /  FIRST CHECK PRESCRIBED RATES
beats.rule: Where rates are prescribed, use the applicable Directorate of Transport rates and the employee's mode entitlement.
beats.example: An officer checks whether the journey is rail-connected and whether the chosen road mode is eligible.
beats.trap: A taxi can be available without being an entitled mode for every pay level.
beats.key: Road mileage is distinct from daily local travel at the tour station.
lines: Intercity road journey में पहले check करें कि concerned State या neighbouring State की Transport Directorate ने specific rates prescribe किए हैं या नहीं।
Prescribed rates हों तो applicable mode और Pay Level की conditions देखें। Example: employee अपनी road journey पर vehicle entitlement और rail connected route की fare condition दोनों check करता है।
Available taxi का मतलब हर Pay Level को हर taxi class की entitlement नहीं है। इसे tour city travel वाली daily ceiling से mix मत करिए।

beats.heading: ROAD TA  /  FALLBACK WHEN NO RATE EXISTS
beats.rule: Where neither relevant Directorate has prescribed rates, the 2017 fallback rates are Rs 24 / 12 per km; the first 25% increase makes them Rs 30 / 15.
beats.example: An otherwise eligible, authorised 40 km own-car journey at the Rs 30 fallback gives Rs 1,200 before other checks.
beats.trap: Fallback rates do not override mode entitlement, route restrictions or duplicate-reimbursement rules.
beats.key: These are calculated fallback rates, not a universal taxi permission.
lines: जहाँ दोनों relevant Transport Directorates ने rates prescribe नहीं किए, twenty seventeen fallback own car या taxi के लिए twenty four और auto या own scooter के लिए twelve rupees per kilometre था।

First twenty five percent increase के बाद ये thirty और fifteen rupees बनते हैं। Example: otherwise eligible और approved own car journey forty kilometres है, तो thirty से multiply करने पर one thousand two hundred rupees का starting calculation बनेगा।
ये calculation vehicle entitlement, route rules और बाकी conditions को override नहीं करता।

beats.heading: 08A  |  Tour, transfer and training
beats.rule: The 2018 OM gives 60 days succeeding completion; an unpreferred claim is forfeited / relinquished.
beats.example: Journey ends 1 Oct: count 2 Oct as day 1; keep submission proof.
beats.trap: Submit to the correct recipient; the deadline is not a payment guarantee.
beats.key: For the worked calendar, day 60 is 30 November 2026.
lines: Tour, transfer या training का टी ए claim normally journey खत्म होने के बाद sixty days में submit करना होता है; late होने पर claim forfeited, यानी lost, माना जा सकता है।
Example: journey first October twenty twenty six को खत्म हुई, तो second October day one है और thirtieth November day sixty।
Correct office में time पर submit करें और proof रखें।

beats.heading: 08B  |  Retirement TA was amended
beats.rule: The retirement-TA submission period is 180 days succeeding the journey, under the 2021 OM.
beats.example: Eligible retirement journey ends 1 Oct 2026: the 180th succeeding day is 30 Mar 2027.
beats.trap: Time to perform a retirement journey and time to submit a claim differ.
beats.key: Some unsettled old claims may be reconsidered: see the guide.
lines: Retirement टी ए में twenty twenty one order ने limit one hundred eighty days after journey कर दी; tour, transfer और training के लिए sixty days रहते हैं।
Example: eligible retirement journey first October twenty twenty six को खत्म हो, तो one hundred eightieth day thirtieth March twenty twenty seven है।
याद रखें: trip करने की eligibility period और claim file करने की deadline अलग बातें हैं। पुरानी unsettled cases पर review की possibility guide में है।

beats.heading: 09A  |  Separate journeys, separate clocks
beats.rule: Transfer journeys by officer and family are reckoned separately; effects use actual delivery.
beats.example: Family arrives ten days after the officer: do not use one starting date for both.
beats.trap: Keep the actual delivery date for personal effects / conveyance.
beats.key: The guide distinguishes transfer examples from retirement claims.
lines: Transfer में अगर employee और family अलग अलग travel करते हैं, तो हर journey के लिए claim clock अलग शुरू होता है।
Example: employee first October और family eleventh October को पहुंची, तो दोनों की completion date अलग count होगी।
Personal effects या conveyance के लिए new station पर actual delivery की date अलग check करें।

beats.heading: 09B  |  Who receives the claim?
beats.rule: The date depends on whether the officer is their own controlling officer.
beats.example: Submitted to controlling officer on time; Treasury receives it later: check para 4.
beats.trap: Self-controlling officers use presentation at Treasury / Cash Section.
beats.key: Correct recipient + documented submission date matter.
lines: Claim कब submit माना जाएगा, ये इस बात पर भी depend करता है कि आप अपने controlling officer खुद हैं या नहीं।
अगर नहीं, तो Head of Office या controlling officer को submission date देखें; अगर आप अपने controlling officer हैं, Treasury या Cash Section में presentation date देखें।
Example: आपने controlling officer को day forty five पर claim दिया और Treasury को बाद में मिला, तो order की conditions के साथ पहले वाली submission date matter कर सकती है।
Receipt या acknowledgement संभाल कर रखें।

sections.title: Missing boarding pass: tour evidence
sections.source: DoE 23 Jun 2020 boarding-pass OM · DoE 16 Jun 2022 booking OM

beats.heading: OFFICIAL UPDATE  /  LOST BOARDING PASS
beats.rule: If the boarding pass cannot be produced, the prescribed self-declaration may accompany the tour TA bill.
beats.example: Level 9: record the actual journey and PNR; get the declaration countersigned.
beats.trap: The 2020 OM is for tours; do not automatically extend it to every journey.
beats.key: Tell the truth, attach the correct certificate, and retain evidence.
lines: Quick official update: boarding pass missing हो, तो क्या करें? DoE का twenty twenty order Central Government की official tour journey के लिए है।
अगर physical और digital copy दोनों नहीं हैं, तो prescribed self declaration टी ए bill के साथ दे सकते हैं।
Example: Level Nine employee अपना pass खो देता है। वो actual journey, पी एन आर और no double claim की details declaration में देता है।
Level Ten और नीचे के employees को controlling officer से declaration countersign कराना है।

beats.heading: OFFICIAL UPDATE  /  TWO DIFFERENT CERTIFICATES
beats.rule: The 2022 journey-completion certificate is different from the 2020 missing-pass declaration.
beats.example: After the flight, send the completion certificate; attach the lost-pass declaration to the TA bill.
beats.trap: Do not assume the 72-hour certificate is the full TA bill.
beats.key: False declarations can trigger disciplinary action and recovery.
lines: ये lost pass declaration, journey completion certificate से अलग है। June twenty twenty two order में completion certificate journey के seventy two hours के अंदर मांगा गया है; टी ए bill अलग rule से बाद में submit होता है।
Example: employee flight के बाद completion certificate भेजता है। Boarding pass नहीं मिला, तो bill के साथ अलग prescribed declaration लगाता है।
False declaration पर disciplinary action और recovery हो सकती है।

sections.title: Transfer TA: components and transfer grant

beats.heading: TRANSFER TA  /  FOUR DIFFERENT HEADS
beats.rule: Transfer TA has four components: travel, CTG, eligible personal effects and eligible conveyance.
beats.example: On an eligible public-interest transfer, list the employee journey, family journey, effects and vehicle separately.
beats.trap: One component being admissible does not automatically sanction the other three.
beats.key: Transfer, retirement and tour have different conditions.
lines: Transfer टी ए में चार अलग heads हैं: employee और eligible family की journey, Composite Transfer Grant यानी सी टी जी, personal effects, और eligible conveyance की transport।
Example: public interest में approved transfer पर employee अपने और family travel, सामान और vehicle को अलग rows में check करता है।
एक head approve होने से बाकी तीन heads automatically approve नहीं होते।

beats.heading: TRANSFER TA  /  CTG IS NOT RETIREMENT CTG
beats.rule: For transfer, the 2017 OM specifies 80% for a change of station at least 20 km apart; closer/same-city cases have a conditional one-third rule.
beats.example: Eligible transfer 20 km or more away; last basic Rs 50,000 → 80% CTG is Rs 40,000.
beats.trap: Own-request restrictions, spouse cases and 2022 retirement CTG have separate conditions.
beats.key: Check transfer purpose, distance, residence and special-region orders.
lines: Transfer वाले twenty seventeen order में, stations के बीच twenty kilometres या ज्यादा दूरी हो तो stated conditions पर सी टी जी last basic pay का eighty percent है।
Example: eligible transfer में last basic fifty thousand rupees है, तो eighty percent यानी forty thousand rupees का सी टी जी check होगा।

Same city या twenty kilometres से कम distance पर actual residence change हो तो stated one third rule देखें। Own request और spouse transfer की restrictions अलग हैं; retirement का twenty twenty two amendment अलग है।

sections.title: 2026 rates and special-region transfers
sections.source: DoE DA OM 22 Apr 2026 · DoP DA-linked allowance circular 5 Jun 2024 · DoE special-region transfer OM 16 Jun 2022

beats.heading: UPDATED RATES  /  WHAT CHANGES AT 60%?
beats.rule: Specified TA rates rose by 25% from 1 January 2024. The DA rise to 60% from 1 January 2026 is not another 50-point trigger.
beats.example: The personal-effects road rate for Levels 6 and above rose from Rs 50 to Rs 62.50 per km, subject to the applicable claim conditions.
beats.trap: Do not apply the 25% increase to every allowance, quantity or kilometre limit.
beats.key: Apply the relevant clause, journey date and documentary requirements.
lines: एक January twenty twenty six से Dearness Allowance sixty percent है।
Fifty से sixty जाने पर eligible टी ए rates में एक और twenty five percent automatic increase नहीं होता।
First revision January twenty twenty four से लागू है।
Example: Level Six और ऊपर personal effects के road transport का rate fifty से sixty two rupees fifty paise per kilometre हो गया; actual claim की conditions अलग check करें।

beats.heading: TRANSFER TA  /  PERSONAL EFFECTS EXCEPTION
beats.rule: For transfer to/from the specified regions, unaccompanied employees may carry up to one-third of their effects entitlement and claim that one-third without a mandatory receipt; accompanied cases require vouchers for the admissible amount.
beats.example: For an eligible Level 7 rail-effects entitlement of 6,000 kg, one-third is up to 2,000 kg, subject to the OM and other applicable conditions.
beats.trap: The no-voucher exception is limited to the specified regions and family-not-accompanying case; it is not a waiver for every transfer.
beats.key: The 16 June 2022 OM applies from its issue date; settled cases are not reopened.
lines: अब एक important transfer exception।

North East Region, Andaman and Nicobar, Lakshadweep या Ladakh से या वहाँ transfer पर, अगर family साथ नहीं जाती, तो personal effects की entitlement का up to one third carry कर सकते हैं, और उस one third claim के लिए receipt mandatory नहीं है।
Family साथ जाए तो admissible amount के लिए receipt जरूरी है।
Example: Level Seven की six thousand kilo rail entitlement का one third, two thousand kilo तक है; बाकी conditions भी check करें।

sections.title: Technical resignation: specific transfer-TA cases
sections.source: DoPT Technical Resignation and Lien OM 24 Nov 2022 · paras 2.1, 3.6.3

beats.heading: DOPT OM  /  TECHNICAL RESIGNATION
beats.rule: The DoPT consolidation explains when resignation is technical and preserves benefits only where otherwise admissible.
beats.example: An employee applies through the proper channel, is selected, and resigns as required for administration.
beats.trap: Calling every resignation technical does not make the conditions true.
beats.key: Verify the accepted resignation, application route and applicable service rules.
lines: Technical resignation के लिए DoPT के twenty twenty two consolidated order को देखें। Proper channel से Government post के लिए apply किया, selection हुई, और administrative reason से resignation देना पड़ा, तो stated conditions पर वो technical हो सकता है।
Example: employee approved channel से दूसरी Government post में select होता है और required resignation देता है। Past service या बाकी benefits अलग rules की conditions पर depend करते हैं।
हर resignation को technical बोल देने से benefits automatic नहीं बनते।

beats.heading: DOPT OM  /  TRANSFER TA IS CONDITIONAL
beats.rule: Paragraph 3.6.3 addresses qualifying open-competition appointments and excludes temporary Central employees with under three years' regular continuous service.
beats.example: A temporary Central employee with two years' regular continuous service falls within that stated exclusion.
beats.trap: Do not generalize the paragraph to every resignation, service or appointment.
beats.key: Transfer TA depends on the exact appointment, status, service and applicable rules.
lines: उसी order के paragraph three point six point three में open competition या interview से Central Government post पर appointment का specific transfer टी ए rule है।

उसमें temporary Central Government employee की regular continuous service तीन साल से कम हो, तो transfer टी ए नहीं मिलता। Permanent या provisionally permanent State employee के लिए भी paragraph की अलग wording देखें।
Example: temporary Central employee की ऐसी service दो साल है, तो वो इस stated exclusion में आता है। बाकी cases में appointment और service status check करना जरूरी है।

sections.title: Retirement grant: the 2022 amendment
sections.source: DoE OM 6 Jan 2022 · 2017 retirement TA order · 2021 claim OM

beats.heading: DOE AMENDMENT  /  RETIREMENT CTG
beats.rule: For retirement settlement, the 2022 OM removes the 20 km condition, subject to an actual change of residence and other conditions.
beats.example: Last basic pay Rs 50,000: qualifying full CTG is Rs 40,000, subject to the applicable rules.
beats.trap: Do not treat old one-third or distance wording as the current general retirement CTG rule.
beats.key: The 2022 order applies from its date of issue and requires a prescribed self-declaration.
lines: Retirement Composite Transfer Grant, यानी सी टी जी, के लिए DoE का six January twenty twenty two amendment important है।

Retirement के बाद settlement में twenty kilometre वाली condition हटाई गई, लेकिन residence का actual change और prescribed declaration जरूरी है। General rate last month's basic pay का eighty percent है, बाकी applicable conditions के साथ।
Example: last basic pay fifty thousand rupees हो, तो eligible full सी टी जी forty thousand rupees बनता है। Order अपनी issue date से effective है।

beats.heading: DOE AMENDMENT  /  ISLANDS AND CLAIM CLOCK
beats.rule: The OM preserves 100% CTG for qualifying settlement to or from A&N and Lakshadweep; the claim clock is a separate question.
beats.example: For qualifying island settlement and Rs 50,000 last basic, check the 100% rate and all conditions.
beats.trap: The time to undertake a retirement move is not the same thing as the claim-submission clock.
beats.key: Rate, settlement conditions, journey timing and filing deadline must each be checked.
lines: Andaman and Nicobar या Lakshadweep island territories से या वहाँ qualifying settlement पर order के मुताबिक सी टी जी last basic pay का one hundred percent है, applicable terms के साथ।
Example: eligible island case में fifty thousand basic pay पर इस rate से fifty thousand rupees check होंगे।
Retirement journey का टी ए claim normally journey के बाद one hundred eighty days में देने वाली rule, move करने की eligibility period से अलग है।

sections.title: Worked tour claim and next steps
sections.source: DoE 2017 Annex 2.A, 2.E · DoE 2020 · DoE 2018 claim OM

beats.heading: WORKED EXAMPLE  /  ONE ELIGIBLE TOUR DAY
beats.rule: For this eligible 9-hour day, food = Rs 787.50; eligible fare and actual city travel are separate.
beats.example: Rs 1,200 train + Rs 300 city taxi + Rs 787.50 food = Rs 2,287.50 before case-specific checks.
beats.trap: No overnight hotel cost is assumed; no free boarding or duplicate claim is assumed.
beats.key: Hypothetical calculation: sanction, entitlement, documents and current orders still apply.
lines: अब पूरा practical case। Level Nine employee eligible official tour पर उसी day सुबह eight से शाम five तक बाहर है। Eligible train fare twelve hundred और actual non ए सी city taxi three hundred rupees है। Free meals या duplicate claim assume नहीं किए हैं।
Nine hours के लिए food reference eleven hundred twenty five का seventy percent, यानी seven hundred eighty seven rupees fifty paise। Hotel stay नहीं है।
Example total: twelve hundred plus three hundred plus seven hundred eighty seven fifty, यानी two thousand two hundred eighty seven rupees fifty paise, बाकी sanction और checks के subject पर।

beats.heading: WORKED EXAMPLE  /  FILE AND CHECK
beats.rule: Submit the eligible tour claim with the required evidence, generally within 60 days after journey completion.
beats.example: The Level 9 traveller records the return date and submits tickets and the prescribed city-travel self-certification.
beats.trap: Later batches must still audit remaining TA rules, exceptions and amendments.
beats.key: LTC has separate rules; it is not the focus of this TA batch.
lines: इस case में return date note करें, ticket और city travel की prescribed self certification रखें, और normally journey के बाद sixty days में claim submit करें।
Example: employee अपनी train proof, actual taxi details और food calculation office को देता है। Late claim automatic approve नहीं होता।
इस batch का main focus official Travelling Allowance है। एल टी सी का अलग reference guide में है। बाकी transfer, retirement और special cases की पूरी audit आगे जारी रहेगी।
